ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible fluke surface exhibits a macro-level ratio of approximately 30% high-intensity white pixels to 70% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region located on the medial-superior quadrant of the left lobe; remainder of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black pixels with high-frequency white speckling concentrated on the outer left lobe and right lobe trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees at the vertex of the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) visible against the water background across the entire span of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a broad convex sweep; right lobe exhibits a more elongated and slender convex-to-linear trajectory terminating in a narrow distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized, circular high-contrast white pixel groups are detected along the distal margin of the right lobe and scattered across the inferior dark region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular white scarring and depigmentation marks concentrated along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast 'coastline' interface between the white medial patch and the black lateral pigmentation on the left lobe.
